intro.en: Most are in Liwan’s Xiguan area; Shangxiajiu and Baohua Road are walked between them. Popular shops queue at meal times, so off-peak visits are best.
intro.zh: 大部分集中在荔湾西关一带，从上下九、宝华路一带步行就能串起来。热门店饭点要排队，建议错峰。

desc.en: Teahouse since 1880. Must eat: shrimp dumplings, siu mai, custard lava buns.
desc.zh: 始于1880年的百年茶楼。必吃：虾饺、烧卖、奶黄流沙包。

meta.en: 20 Dishifu Road, Liwan (Shangxiajiu)

desc.en: The classic Cantonese restaurant. Must eat: Wenchang chicken, shrimp dumplings, roast meats.
desc.zh: 粤菜代表。必吃：文昌鸡、虾饺、烧味。

meta.en: 2 Wenchang South Road, Liwan
meta.zh: 荔湾区文昌南路2号

desc.en: Famous for lotus-paste pastries. Must buy: lotus-paste mooncakes, wife cakes, chicken biscuits.
desc.zh: 地道糕饼名店。必买：莲蓉月饼、老婆饼、鸡仔饼。

meta.en: 67 Dishifu Road, Liwan
meta.zh: 荔湾区第十甫路67号

desc.en: Lingnan garden restaurant. Must eat: water-chestnut cake, sampan congee, classic dim sum.
desc.zh: 岭南园林式老字号。必吃：马蹄糕、艇仔粥、传统粤点。

desc.zh: 传统广式牛奶甜品。必吃：双皮奶、姜撞奶。

meta.en: 47 Dishifu Road, Liwan
meta.zh: 荔湾区第十甫路47号

desc.en: Classic Xiguan cloth-steamed rice rolls. Must eat: shrimp and beef rice rolls.
desc.zh: 经典西关布拉肠粉。必吃：鲜虾肠粉、牛肉肠粉。

meta.en: 345 Wenchang North Road, Liwan
meta.zh: 荔湾区文昌北路345号

desc.en: Old Guangzhou wonton noodles. Must eat: fresh shrimp wonton noodles, fried wontons.
desc.zh: 老广州传统云吞面。必吃：鲜虾云吞面、炸云吞。

meta.en: 20 Helong Lane, Datong Road, Liwan
meta.zh: 荔湾区大同路和隆里20号

desc.en: Traditional congee shop. Must eat: jidi congee, sampan congee, salted fried cakes.
desc.zh: 传统广式粥品老店。必吃：及第粥、艇仔粥、咸煎饼。

meta.en: 871 Longjin East Road, Liwan

desc.zh: 怀旧广式冰室。必吃：椰子雪糕、芒果雪糕。

meta.en: 83 Baohua Road, Liwan

subtitle.en: Milk tea and Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea

intro.zh: 手打柠檬茶是广州自己的潮流，奶茶店到处都是。点单时可以选甜度。

desc.en: Guangzhou’s best-known hand-pounded lemon tea. Look for the duck mascot; copycat shops exist.
desc.zh: 广州最出名的手打柠檬茶，认准鸭子周边，市面上有山寨店。

when.en: Not on the route; many branches

desc.zh: 批发市场：挑之前先问“这个可以单买吗？”“可以试穿吗？”。商场：明码标价，可问会员优惠，不用讲价。准备微信/支付宝和少量现金。拍档口前先问。盲盒先定预算，拆了一般不能退。

desc.en: Ersha Island sports street closed in 2016. 西城都荟 is now 荔湾领展广场. Fangcun tea market is being redeveloped. Not all Tianhe malls connect underground yet (Parc Central–Grandview link under construction). 天河路天河城, 北京路天河城 and 番禺天河城 are different places; 万菱广场 is not 万菱汇.
desc.zh: 二沙岛体育用品街2016年已清退。西城都荟现名荔湾领展广场。芳村茶叶市场正在改造。天河商场并非全部地下连通（天环–正佳连廊在建）。天河路天河城、北京路天河城、番禺天河城是三个地方；万菱广场不是万菱汇。

intro.en: Three clusters fit the hotels: Liwan (Dec 21–23), Beijing Road for anime and gifts, and the Tianhe Road malls (from Dec 27). Info checked 3 Nov 2026; hours and stock can change. ¥ budget · ¥¥ mid · ¥¥¥ premium.
intro.zh: 按酒店分三块：荔湾（12/21–23）、北京路一带买动漫和手信、天河路商圈（12/27起）。资料核对于2026年11月3日，营业时间和库存可能变化。¥ 平价 · ¥¥ 中档 · ¥¥¥ 高端。

subtitle.en: The right exit at 8 tricky stations

intro.en: Reaching the right station is not enough; the wrong exit can mean a long detour. Navigate to the exact sight, mall entrance or hotel, not just the station.
intro.zh: 到了正确的地铁站，不代表就能轻松找到景点。导航时要输入具体景点、商场入口或酒店地址，不要只输入站名。

desc.en: Beijing Road, People’s Park, Animation City. Beijing Road is long, so the north or south end should be decided first.
desc.zh: 北京路、人民公园、动漫星城。北京路步行街范围很大，先确定要去北段还是南段。

meta.en: Lines 1, 2
meta.zh: 1号线 · 2号线

desc.en: Teemall, Grandview Mall, Parc Central. The three malls are in different directions; the right one should be picked before exiting.
desc.zh: 天河城、正佳广场、天环。三个商场位置不同，先认清要去哪一个。

meta.en: Lines 1, 3
meta.zh: 1号线 · 3号线

desc.en: Mall of the World, Huacheng Square, Guangzhou Opera House. Huacheng Square is long; the right exit depends on the destination.
desc.zh: 高德置地、花城汇、广州大剧院。花城广场范围很长，目的地不同，出口也不同。

meta.en: Lines 3, 5, APM
meta.zh: 3号线 · 5号线 · APM

desc.en: Canton Tower, riverside, Haixin Bridge. The tower and the bridge are reached in different directions; the signs should be checked.
desc.zh: 广州塔、珠江边、海心桥。去广州塔和走海心桥方向不一样，先看清指示牌。

meta.en: Line 3, APM
meta.zh: 3号线 · APM

desc.en: Yongqingfang, Shangxiajiu, Hengbao Plaza. Neither is right outside the exit; navigate to the entrance.
desc.zh: 永庆坊、上下九、恒宝广场。永庆坊不是一出站就到，上下九也要走一段，先导航具体入口。

meta.en: Line 1
meta.zh: 1号线

desc.en: Chen Clan Academy, Liwan old streets. The sight entrance should be confirmed, not just the station name.
desc.zh: 陈家祠、荔湾老街。认清景点入口，不要只看地铁站名。

meta.en: Line 1
meta.zh: 1号线

title.en: Guangzhou East Railway Station (广州东站)

desc.en: Railway station, Dongfang Baotai mall, nearby hotels. Station, mall and hotel exits point different ways.
desc.zh: 火车站、东方宝泰、周边酒店。火车站入口、商场入口和酒店方向要分清。

meta.en: Lines 1, 3
meta.zh: 1号线 · 3号线

desc.en: Chimelong Paradise, Safari Park, Chimelong Hotel. The resort is huge with separate entrances; follow the shuttle signs.
desc.zh: 长隆欢乐世界、野生动物世界、长隆酒店。园区很大，不同园区入口不同，留意接驳指示。

meta.en: Lines 3, 7
meta.zh: 3号线 · 7号线

desc.en: Beijing Road → Gongyuanqian C · Parc Central → Tiyu Xilu B · Huacheng Square → Zhujiang New Town A1 · Canton Tower → Canton Tower B · Shangxiajiu → Changshou Lu A · Chen Clan Academy → Chen Jia Ci E · Dongfang Baotai → Guangzhou East B1 · Chimelong → Hanxi Changlong E
desc.zh: 北京路步行街 → 公园前C · 天环广场 → 体育西路B · 花城广场 → 珠江新城A1 · 广州塔 → 广州塔B · 上下九步行街 → 长寿路A · 陈家祠景区 → 陈家祠E · 东方宝泰 → 广州东站B1 · 长隆度假区 → 汉溪长隆E

desc.en: The nearest exit may not have a lift. With kids or a stroller, routes and exits should be checked in advance. Station signs and live navigation take priority on the day.
desc.zh: 最近的出口不一定有无障碍电梯；带小孩或推婴儿车，建议提前查看路线和出口；出行当天以站内指示及实时导航为准。
